encode_text_with_fastbpe: encode a string using the fastBPE encoder by calling the encode method with text input
decode_text_with_fastbpe: decode a BPE-encoded string back to original text using the decode method
initialize_fastbpe_encoder: initialize a fastBPE encoder instance by passing args with a bpe_codes path
add_fastbpe_args_to_parser: add the --bpe-codes argument to an argparse parser using the add_args static method
register_fastbpe_bpe: register the fastBPE encoder with fairseq using the register_bpe decorator with name fastbpe
